_comment: Phase 71 example article — TWOLAYER, and the article that finally makes the master REACHABLE (the `rust -> TwoLayer` name exception; class metal -> Opaque otherwise, so nothing could ever bind it). The defining observable is TWO LAYERS THAT ARE VISIBLY TWO: bright polished metallic steel under dark orange non-metallic flaking rust, with the maskset saying where the rust sits. Each layer carries its OWN base colour / roughness / metalness / normal. ⚠ `maskset_blend` MUST be nonzero — the blend is t = k * maskset_blend, so at the schema default of 0 layer 2 is invisible however well it is authored (71.7 enforces this).
name: Rust_OnSteel_Flaking_Base_s01_v01
